notes.title: First Announcement Trailer Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]It has been 2 years since we first opened our Steam page and began sharing the journey of Aether Wizard Life with you. And guess what? Our very first announcement trailer is finally here![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43197136/20aa02b76f2e231ec3a034d36b930263f8cb8eda.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In it, you’ll spot our hand-drawn 2D art style and a peek at the things you’ll get to do, like brewing potions, exploring dungeons, building your own castle, making friends, and learning over 30 wizard skills.
[/p][p]You can watch it on our Steam page at [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2195450/Aether_Wizard_Life/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] or on YouTube at [/p][previewyoutube="inYb1szfRQE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A playable demo is coming soon and we cannot wait for you to step into the world we have been crafting together.[/p][p]Follow and wishlist the game so you will be the first to know when the demo is ready.[/p][p]
Thanks!,
Vonder Games[/p]
